chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from the one he mentioned, from Khaithama ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Ju'fi, who said: Isa ibn Abdullah al-Qummi asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), while I was present,
He said: What is worship? He said: Good intention in obedience, from the aspect from which Allah is obeyed.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of worship in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise definition from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) distinguishes between mere ritual performance and the spiritual essence of worship, linking 'good intention' directly to the divine command. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity) as the criterion that validates external acts, ensuring they are performed 'from the angle from which God is obeyed.'
